name: Quartz & Countertops
tagline: Compare slab, colour, thickness and price before you commit
description: The countertop is the most-used surface in the house and the one clients complain about first. This section exists so a designer can put engineered quartz, natural stone, solid surface and sintered stone side by side on colour, slab size, thickness, application and price before recommending one.

materials.name: Engineered quartz
materials.blurb: 93% quartz in resin — non-porous, consistent, no sealing
materials.description: Crushed quartz bound in resin gives a slab that never needs sealing and repeats exactly from batch to batch. The default premium kitchen counter in India; keep hot vessels off it, as the resin scorches.

materials.name: Granite countertop
materials.blurb: The Indian workhorse — heat-proof and forgiving
materials.description: Handles hot kadhais, heavy chopping and turmeric better than almost anything else, at a fraction of quartz cost. Seal it once a year and it will outlast the kitchen around it.

specs.Colours: Black galaxy, steel grey, Kashmir white

materials.name: Marble countertop
materials.blurb: Beautiful, soft, and it will patina — tell the client first
materials.description: Nothing looks like real marble, and nothing stains like it either. Best on vanities, dry bars and baking counters where the client actively wants the stone to age.

materials.name: Solid surface
materials.blurb: Seamless acrylic surface — joints disappear, damage sands out
materials.description: Sheets are thermoformed and bonded into one continuous surface with no visible joints, integrated sinks included. Scratches and burns sand out completely, which makes it the most repairable counter on the market.

materials.name: Sintered stone
materials.blurb: Ultra-compact slab — heat, UV and scratch proof
materials.description: Mineral powder fused under extreme pressure and heat, producing the toughest surface available: hot pans directly on it, full UV stability, and thin enough for outdoor kitchens and façades.

materials.name: Porcelain slab
materials.blurb: Large-format thin slab for counters and full-height cladding
materials.description: 1200×2400 mm and larger sheets at 6–12 mm, so a wall or an island can be clad with almost no joints. Light enough to go over existing surfaces during a renovation.
